name: Remove Single Product Meta for WooCommerce
author: Brad Dalton

sections.description:
Remove Single Product Meta allows you to control the visibility of various elements on WooCommerce single product pages. You can remove elements globally for all products or set individual settings per product.

Features

  • Remove product ratings
  • Remove related products
  • Remove product categories
  • Remove product tags
  • Remove product meta information
  • Global settings for all products
  • Individual settings per product
  • Compatible with both traditional and block themes
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)

Use Cases

  • Clean up product pages by removing unnecessary elements
  • Create a more focused product presentation
  • Customize product pages for different product types
  • Maintain consistent product page layout across your store
  • Optimize product pages for better conversion rates

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data. It only modifies the display of product elements on your WooCommerce store.

Credits

  • Built with WooCommerce
  • Compatible with WordPress block editor
  • Uses WooCommerce HPOS features

Support

For support, please visit https://wpsites.net/contact/ or create an issue.

Roadmap

Future plans include:
* Additional element removal options
* Custom CSS injection
* Element reordering
* Template override options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/remove-single-product-elements directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the WooCommerce > Settings > Remove Elements screen to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with block themes?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with both traditional WooCommerce themes and block themes using the block editor.

Can I set different settings for different products?

Yes, you can set global settings that apply to all products, and you can also set individual settings for each product in the product editor.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) feature.

Does this plugin affect product performance?

No, this plugin only removes elements from the display and does not affect the underlying product data or performance.
